about_the_game:
Now, who are you? A striker unstoppable, a defense like a wall, a goalie of impossible saves?! Just follow the call and climb up the career ladders, GOKA Street challenges you!

Imagine becoming a powerful horse with awesome kicks, or choosing to be a cool cyborg with amazing skills or even a forest fairy who creates watermelon rains. Create your character however you want.

At its heart, GOKA Street is a social, competitive football experience; quick to learn, hard to master, and always unpredictable.

Different game modes will unite you with your friends and players around the globe. Up to 6 player matches in career path & custom rooms await to test your skills. There are trophies to be won, goals to be scored, skills to be displayed, and minds to be blown! Prepare yourself for one of the most extraordinary football games, with moves you can unlock along the way — curved shots, bicycle kicks, spectacular dribbles…

There are no whistles, no pauses, no endless fouls. The game never stops. Every second on the street is alive with action, rebounds, and last-second saves. It’s football freed from the rules that slow it down; pure, raw, and always in motion.

GOKA Street characters may look overly cute, quirky, and clumsy, but at their core they’re excellent footballers. Unlike other street football games, this one isn’t just about stiff animations you trigger and wait to finish; every move can be combined and flows seamlessly. Just join our Discord channel and see the amazing combos our Beta players have already discovered!

Gameplay system makes it easy to jump in but deep enough to master. From curved shots that bend around defenders to bicycle kicks that steal the spotlight, GOKA’s controls give you the tools to play your own style of street football.

Everything in GOKA is customizable. From your player’s look to the wild skins, accessories, and animations you unlock, every detail lets you create a style that represents you. Whether you want to be a futuristic cyborg, a mythical creature, or just the most stylish baller on the block, the street is yours to own.

A ton of bombastic modes for every taste! The ultimate street football experience where rules are few, creativity is endless, and every match is unpredictable chaos. Forget 11 vs 11: this is football stripped down to its purest, wildest form. Score, defend, and survive in fast-paced matches where a single goal can turn you from an unstoppable striker into a flawless goalkeeper.

In ONE BAR mode, dominate your opponents by scoring goals and show them who the ultimate striker is.

Those who love goalkeeping are in luck! In KING OF THE BARS, scoring alone isn’t enough to win. After you’ve captured the goal, you must defend it with all your might as its goalkeeper. In this mode, goals are scored *in the goal! And if you’ve got a friend with you, you have to try the TEAMED version! While the scorer becomes the goalkeeper, their teammate will take on the role of defender in the penalty area.

What about three friends coming together to beat their rivals? Then step right into TWO BARS mode. Passes, crosses, bicycle kicks... all flying through the air, just like real street football!

Want something old-school? Step into FULL TEAM mode! Here, you’ll control the entire team. It’s more traditional, yet you’ll feel the spirit of GOKA Street in every second.

Of course, you can always create a CUSTOM ROOM! A space to hang out, train, and experiment with friends. No points, no pressure; just practice, tricks, and fun.

Key Features

  • Customization → Get ready to go crazy and creative with one of the most unique customization systems ever!

  • Season Path → Unlock exclusive rewards and cosmetics tied to each season’s theme.

  • Cup Road → Progress by collecting cups from your matches. Each step on the path unlocks new items, coins, game modes, and even special moves to expand your arsenal.

  • League System → Climb divisions, face tougher rivals, and build your street legacy. Earn points through promotion and unlock new characters on League Road!

  • Custom Rooms → Your friends, your rules!

For better and deeper experience just join us on Discord!

Follow us on social media and get to know us better!

short_description: GOKA Street is a multiplayer street football game built for fast-paced action & endless replayability. It combines arcade-style gameplay with real football mechanics. With battle royale-flavored unique modes, it invites up to 6 players to kick up the dust on the streets. Just show ’em what you got!
supported_languages: English, Turkish, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal
